newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER CITY'S SEARCH FOR A MANAGER GOES ON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER CITY'S SEARCH FOR A MANAGER GOES ON.

text.p: Former Manchester City full-back Willie Donachie has turned down the chance to return to the troubled English first division club as manager.
Donachie said on Monday he had decided to remain as Everton's first team coach.
"It was obviously a temptation because of my strong feelings for City but I feel a great obligation to stay at Everton. I love the job," said the ex-Scotland international.
Former Arsenal manager George Graham and Crystal Palace boss Dave Bassett have also rejected offers to fill the vacancy left by Alan Ball's departure just three games into the season.
